purpose: Bind every declared Mechanicus function to explicit evidence or to an explicit deferred/forbidden status without claiming full organ closure.
rules: Every non-future/non-forbidden function in MECHANICUS_FUNCTION_REGISTRY_V0_1 must have at least one evidence path.
Every required evidence path must exist inside the current repository root.
JSON evidence paths must parse as JSON.
PROVEN_BASELINE functions must include receipt or validator-backed evidence, not only prose.
MEASURED_PRESENT and PARTIAL_MEASURED functions may pass baseline with existing evidence but must not claim full semantic closure.
FUTURE_DEFERRED functions must remain deferred and must not be counted as missing evidence.
FORBIDDEN functions must remain forbidden and must not be counted as capability proof.
The gate may set G3 to PASS_BASELINE but must not claim MECHANICUS_ASSEMBLED or SIX_GATES_100_PERCENT_CLOSED.
Local model membrane remains DEFERRED_AFTER_CORE_V1 and is not evidence authority.
pass_meaning: Declared current Mechanicus functions have explicit evidence bindings or explicit deferred/forbidden status; G3 reaches baseline readiness only.
pass_does_not_mean: Custodes prosecutor has accepted the organ
